Opposition Urges Supreme Court to Halt Voter Deletion Process

An opposition coalition, the INDIA bloc, has filed a petition with the Supreme Court of India requesting a halt to the ongoing Special Summary Revision (SSR) process. The bloc seeks the formation of an independent committee to audit voter deletions, listing ten specific requests in their petition. The core of their demand is to pause the SSR and conduct an audit of voter deletions.
